evidence.detail: rs/w/c directly owns javax.sound.midi.Sequence, Sequencer and Synthesizer instances and coordinates them as one playback object.
Its public methods load/play MIDI content, start playback with configurable volume/loop behavior, stop/close playback and expose track/source metadata strings.
The class configures MIDI Receiver channels/controllers to apply a floating-point volume scalar while routing playback through the active synthesizer/sequencer.
The classic runtime bridge rs/v/a holds a static rs/w/c instance, tying this object to client music playback rather than generic MIDI utilities.

proposals.note: MidiPlayer is the conservative semantic name for this exact Java-MIDI playback wrapper; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
